title: Sensory-context modulation of optogenetic calcium response investigation
disposition_reason: The full140 route is a public-input structural report admission, not a numerical investigation scorer. Source memberships span three original blocks and a separate revision pool; no independent-cell or animal map justifies pooled140 biological estimates.

scientific_target.question: What measured incremental optogenetic response contrasts differ across visual contexts within each original source block, and does the evidence support an interaction beyond additive visual/opto responses?
scientific_target.known_answer: Prespecified within-block differences of matched visual-plus-opto, visual-only and opto-only response summaries, plus available-context support and original-versus-revision-pool discrepancies, independently recomputed from measured traces.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Public measured calcium condition arrays in sequenceFiltering.zip record18726362. Historical full140 declaration specifies18 array members and866 numeric operands but returns structural acceptance only; neither this operand count nor a valid report guarantees correct estimates.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete public investigation retaining original_expt1/2/3 and revision_pool as separate blocks; membership rows can repeat biological cells.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Unresolved animal/acquisition grouping.140 memberships are neither140 independent cells nor140 animals; revision_pool must remain separate.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Descriptive within-source-block sensory-context interaction analysis. Physical120ms equivalence, pooled cell count, animal inference and full-paper reproduction require evidence absent from the retained route.
exclusions: No forced reconciliation to115 cells or six animals.
No pooled140 biological effect or population confidence interval.
No numerical accuracy, causal explanation or general neural understanding from schema acceptance alone.

inputs: Complete permitted condition traces for each source block, with visual/opto condition metadata and native frame axes.

forbidden_inputs: Trusted expected report, private answer operands or evaluator feedback.

observation_contract.split: This is an exposed public-data investigation, not hidden-target prediction. Compute within declared blocks and compare original/revision support explicitly; any train/query prediction extension needs a separate complete condition split.

primary.name: within_block_interaction_report_numerical_error
primary.aggregation: Compare every prespecified native-unit incremental-opto and interaction contrast, support count and undefined disposition with independent recomputation; retain separate source blocks and frozen tolerances.
primary.rationale: Scores correct extraction and inference from measured observations rather than agreement with a narrative or mere presence of866 numbers. Exact report arithmetic must be recovered before scoring.

secondary: Report additive-model residual contrasts with visual-only/opto-only controls wherever the required conditions exist.
Original-block versus revision-pool support and sensitivity; missing conditions remain unavailable.
Explicit source membership duplication, frame-window definitions and optical-artifact sensitivity.

comparators.name: Additive visual plus opto response
comparators.inputs: Matched visual-only, opto-only and baseline conditions within each block.
comparators.procedure: Compute additive expected response using fixed native-frame summaries; if a required condition is absent, mark interaction unavailable.

comparators.name: Context-dependent incremental opto response
comparators.inputs: Matched visual-plus-opto and visual-only observations within source block.
comparators.procedure: Estimate within-block difference and its contrast across contexts; do not pool revision/original arrays to inflate precision.

comparators.name: Artifact/window sensitivity
comparators.inputs: Equivalent unstimulated/baseline windows and power/timing metadata where measured.
comparators.procedure: Prespecify diagnostics in native frames until physical clocks are verified; do not invent120ms equivalence.

nuisance_controls: Keep original source blocks and revision_pool separate, with every membership and condition documented.
Match optical power/timing and inspect optical artifacts before biological interpretation.
Distinguish condition-mean arrays from independent trial measurements.
Retain unavailable contrasts when required controls are absent; do not force a common full-factorial design.
evaluation.uncertainty: No animal-level or independent-cell interval until source membership and acquisition→mouse mapping are resolved. Report descriptive within-block results; no pooled140 replicate count and no inference from report-operand quantity.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require the complete declared report and all source blocks; reject wrong/missing/duplicated terms and preserve unavailable contrasts. Structural admission must be followed by independent numerical grading; a scientifically wrong but well-shaped report cannot earn correctness.
